summary_md: **[@KitchExtremeX](https://x.com/KitchExtremeX/status/2115497618944282892)** points to Anthropic's **single-agent-loop-kit**, a Claude Code skill for folding subagents back into one agent loop with skills and tools. It evaluates every change, so splitting work into a subagent happens only when the eval numbers justify it.
relevance: An eval-gated approach to the single-agent vs multi-agent decision, from a model vendor.
